text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme Disease (Erythema Migrans with disseminated joint and musculoskeletal involvement).

Given the camping trip in Minnesota, recent self-resolving knee pain, and now wrist pain with fever and skin lesions, this clinical picture strongly suggests early disseminated Lyme disease. I am requesting images to confirm the presence of Erythema Migrans. REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology_scan_wrist
